chunks: And from a letter from him (peace be upon him and his family) to Mu'awiya also.

key_terms.أَيْضًا: Also/likewise, indicating this is one of several letters or communications
key_terms.مُعَاوِيَة: Mu'awiya, the Umayyad governor and later Caliph, recipient of the letter

ai.seo_question: What is the title of Imam Ali's letter to Muawiya in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces the famous letter from Imam Ali (AS) to Muawiya, serving as a concise preamble to his detailed exposition of the caliphate's legitimacy and the events of the Battle of Siffin. It highlights the direct diplomatic engagement between the two leaders, framing the subsequent text as a formal argument for Ali's right to rule based on divine appointment and prophetic precedent.
